purpose: Gate findings the project has accepted as debt. A permanently red gate teaches everyone to ignore it, so accepted findings are listed here with a reason and counted separately. Anything absent from this file blocks. Never add an entry to silence a finding about work in progress: waive only what a past commit already shipped, and clear a family's waivers when you next touch that family.
